editions.notas_pt: A xStocks publicou tres vezes sobre o $ANTx (Ether.fi 08:54Z, 'Claude made no mistakes' 07:47Z e Zerion 10:08Z) e a Anthropic aparece caindo 6% no premarket na UW: o dia gira em torno do mesmo ativo em dois angulos. A WatcherGuru entrou pela primeira vez desde a liberacao - ouro abaixo de US$ 3.550, 7,5 mil likes, maior alcance do dia. Angulo (b) variado de proposito (gap vs preco sem sino, profundidade no crash das 2h, agentes que nao dormem, execucao depois do report, distribuicao). Nenhum numero fora da fonte primaria. Logs de 19/11 dos tres reporteros continuam ausentes.

editions.fonte_scan: varredura da mesa sobre as contas nucleares; 5 replies, nenhuma repetida da manha

replies.pt: S&P 500 entra oficialmente em correcao, 10% abaixo da maxima historica.
replies.a: correction is such a gentle word for what just happened to everyone's portfolio
replies.b: the bell rings at 4pm. the correction doesn't. that gap is the whole reason tokenized equities exist
replies.c: corrections are just the market doing cardio

replies.pt: Michael Burry diz que fechou metade da posicao short em Nvidia.
replies.a: shorted nvidia, covered half, and it's still the trade of the year
replies.b: he can change his mind at 2am. onchain the position moves the second he does
replies.c: half a short is a hedge with extra steps

replies.pt: 17.500 holders de $ANTx em menos de 24h, tokenizado 1:1 pela xStocks e no ar na Kraken.
replies.a: 17,500 holders before the stock had a full trading session. gud timeline we live in
replies.b: a Nasdaq debut and an onchain pool on the same day. that's the version of the market that never sleeps
replies.c: the shareholder base is younger than the ticker. no notes

replies.pt: 262.976 traders liquidados em 24h, US$ 1,54 bi no total.
replies.a: 262,976 people took the same class in 24 hours. tuition was steep
replies.b: liquidations don't check the clock. that's the exact gap 24/7 venues were built to fill
replies.c: 1.5 billion gone and the timeline still calls it a healthy pullback

replies.pt: SpaceX contratou cinco lobistas democratas veteranos antes da nova maioria no Congresso.
replies.a: hiring five lobbyists is the most honest earnings call a private company can make
replies.b: lobbyists keep DC hours. the market pricing musk news doesn't keep hours at all
replies.c: regulation is just a product launch with better lawyers

editions.notas_pt: Fora: Mantle 17:44Z e Securitize 17:41Z (mesmo fato do $ANTx por outra rail, e o tema ja foi na manha), Sky 14:51Z (resposta ao CoinDesk sobre o PSM, tom defensivo), Bybit 17:00Z ('go long or short', linguagem de trade que a gente nao usa).

editions.fonte_scan: varredura da mesa sobre as contas nucleares; 5 replies, nenhuma repetida da manha ou da tarde

replies.pt: Odds de o BTC cair abaixo de US$ 55 mil ate o fim do mes saltam para 47%.
replies.a: 47% is the most honest number in crypto. the other 53% is cope
replies.b: odds markets never sleep either. the stock market shuts at 4pm, right in the middle of the panic - onchain keeps quoting
replies.c: every crash is the same crash, just a new crowd discovering leverage

replies.pt: GTA 6 vira o maior lancamento de entretenimento da historia com US$ 3,79 bi no primeiro dia.
replies.a: $3.79B in 24h and my guy still can't load the map
replies.b: a launch this big and the ticker only trades 9:30 to 4. imagine pricing that hype around the clock, on Mantle
replies.c: we waited 12 years for a game to out-earn the box office in one day. patience apparently pays

replies.pt: Mercado derretendo: QQQ e SPY caem mais de 3%, NVDA mais de 10%, 'extreme fear'.
replies.a: extreme fear is when you check the portfolio, then check it again 4 seconds later
replies.b: their book closed at 4pm. ours just kept printing red all night, 24/7 on Mantle - that's the feature
replies.c: 'extreme fear' is a fancy way of saying everyone sold to everyone at the same second

replies.pt: SEC investiga a Nvidia por possiveis problemas contabeis.
replies.a: auditors finding out the AI revenue is GPUs sold to other AI companies
replies.b: accounting questions on an AI giant, priced by a market that closes at 4pm. onchain at least shows the receipts live
replies.c: if the numbers were clean the filing would be boring. nobody investigates boring

replies.pt: Nadella diz que a IA foi o motivo de oferecer buyouts a ~60 mil funcionarios em vez de demissao em massa.
replies.a: 60,000 buyouts and the AI still can't write a meeting invite under 4 paragraphs
replies.b: 60k people out and the ticker keeps ticking 24/7. the market prices the reorg before the email lands
replies.c: calling it a buyout instead of a layoff is the most expensive euphemism in tech

Ficaram de fora os posts de promo/teaser (Bybit, Mantle hackathon), os cortes de podcast da unusual_whales, os itens de carteira anonima da lookonchain e os posts sem texto proprio (elonmusk) - todos listados em discarded_tips.
